products.subcategory: oversize front rotor kit (280mm, solid mount)
products.product: GBrakes 280mm Non-Floating Wave Rotor Plus Bracket, KTM / Husqvarna / GasGas 125-530cc
products.what_it_changes: Retailer copy: 'significantly better lever feel and increased braking torque'; 280mm rotor plus caliper relocation bracket.
products.supporting_parts: Kit includes the 280mm rotor and relocation bracket; pads not listed.
products.caveats: J&P also lists Husqvarna FC/FX/TC/TX and KTM 250-450 SX-F/XC-F models without years, so those were not recorded. J&P lists GasGas MC 250F/MC 450F 2024-2025; those years have Braktec calipers per the KTM family pass 2 finding, so check caliper type before fitting (the Slavens Galfer listing in brakes_controls bc-001 says Brembo calipers only). Galfer's own 280mm application PDF (galfer.eu -> galfer.com) could not be fetched. Title says 2009-2027 while URL says 2009-2025.

products.product: Flame Fixed Rear Rotor, Yamaha 125-450cc 2020-2027
products.what_it_changes: Retailer copy: hardened stainless steel; flame cut-outs help cool and clean the contact surface; laser cut, CNC machined, double ground.
products.caveats: No YZ125X line shown. J&P list also shows Beta and GasGas EC lines (probably cross-listed vehicles); not recorded. List truncated (293 vehicles).

products.product: Flame Floating Front Rotor Kit 270mm, Kawasaki 250-450cc
products.what_it_changes: Kit: Flame MX 270mm front rotor, billet aluminium caliper relocation bracket and Moto-Master Nitro Sport pads.
products.caveats: J&P shows KX450F only to 2018 and no 2019+ KX450 line, while it shows KX450X 2021-2023; KX450 2020-2023 not recorded. Title says to 2023 but KX250/KX250X 2024 are listed. The page also prints GasGas/Honda/Husqvarna lines that look like cross-listing from sibling kits; not recorded.

products.product: Flame 260mm Floating Front Rotor, KTM / Husqvarna / GasGas 85cc
products.what_it_changes: Retailer copy: up to 25% performance gain and up to 20% weight saving claimed; billet CNC aluminium hub, stainless floaters, ground stainless outer ring.
products.supporting_parts: Needs a caliper relocation adapter bracket, sold separately.
products.caveats: No Moto-Master part number on the page. The 2025+ 85 SX is a new platform (README); this listing still names it to 2027 without comment. GasGas MC 85 and Husqvarna TC 85 also listed (not in roster).

products.product: Nitro Front Brake Pads (sintered), GasGas / Husqvarna / KTM
products.what_it_changes: Sintered MX/enduro pad 'designed for general use in varying conditions' (retailer copy).
products.caveats: KTM 85 SX listed only to 2020 while GasGas MC 85 is listed 2021-2027, so the 2021-2024 KTM 85 SX may also fit but is not stated. List truncated.

products.product: MXS368 Race Series Rear Brake Pads
products.what_it_changes: Maker copy via retailer: motocross race pad, sintered copper alloy made at EBC's USA plant; race use only.
products.caveats: Fitment list truncated after Husqvarna FC250; KTM lines not visible though the same pad shape is used across the group. Lists GasGas 2024+ (Braktec front, rear caliper unconfirmed). EBC part finder not checked.

products.product: FA368R R Series Sintered Rear Brake Pads

fits.notes: SportbikeTrackGear: '2023 KTM 250 SX-F FE' (STG number E|1433-FA368R|126)
Dennis Kirk: listed as exact fit for 2024 KTM 250 XC (mfg part FA368R)

products.what_it_changes: Sintered bronze long-life off-road pad for mud, dust or sand; OEM replacement (retailer copy).
products.caveats: List truncated before KTM/Husqvarna. Retailer fitment only. KTM lines added from SportbikeTrackGear (2023 250 SX-F) and Dennis Kirk (2024 250 XC). SportbikeTrackGear separately lists the FA368R rear for GasGas MC 250F 2021-2024 (STG number E|1433-FA368R|21).

products.product: Sintered HH Brake Pads for KTM / Husqvarna / GasGas (front or rear)
products.what_it_changes: Dealer copy: sintered, 'HH rated pad with excellent feel and modulation'.
products.caveats: No Galfer part numbers on the page (SKU N/A). Family wording expanded by us to roster bikes. The dealer says 'all' 2021-26 GasGas, which does not account for the 2024+ Braktec front caliper; the front pad fit on 2024+ GasGas is doubtful. Triumph fit stated by dealer without years.

products.product: Floating Wave Front Rotor DF606FLW (KTM)

fits.notes: Galfer release: 'Compatible with KTM 2012-2023 SX and SXF models'

products.what_it_changes: Maker claims: full floating for optimum pad-to-rotor contact; replaces stock rotor; 420 stainless, laser cut, double-disc ground, heat treated; KBA and TUV approved; made in Spain.

rider_feedback.source: Vital MX comment on the release
rider_feedback.summary: One commenter (Madc32) said two earlier Galfer-equipped bikes had pad damage from rotor edge burrs and wondered if these would be deburred. Anecdote only.

products.caveats: Press release from October 2022; price is the 2022 retail figure. Family wording expanded by us; XC models not named. Fixed version DF606W is in brakes_controls (bc-004).

products.product: Sport Carbon X brake pads (FA181X / FA368X)

fits.notes: Dennis Kirk: 'exact fit' for 2024 KTM 250 XC

products.what_it_changes: EBC Carbon X compound pads (no further claims on the page).
products.caveats: Dennis Kirk does not state front/rear. Fitment checked for one bike-year only (2024 250 XC); the same pad shapes are shared across the KTM group but that is not stated here.

products.product: FA181R Long-Life Sintered R-Series and FA181HH Double-H Sintered pads

fits.notes: Dennis Kirk: 'exact fit' for 2024 KTM 250 XC; FA181HH listed as 'Front or Rear'

products.what_it_changes: Sintered metal pads; HH is EBC's highest friction rating (name only, no claim quoted).
products.caveats: Position not stated for FA181R. Race version MXS181 is in brakes_controls (bc-009). One bike-year checked.

products.caveats: Only M726-S47 is labelled front; the others give no position. Pairing of 1721-xxxx Parts Unlimited numbers to M-numbers is not stated. One bike-year checked.

products.product: Batfly Rear Rotor, KTM / Husqvarna (Braking #32-5245)
products.what_it_changes: Maker copy via retailer: non-round directional Batfly profile, laser-cut AISI 410 stainless, heat treated, CNC finished; alternating grooves to shed heat and renew the pad surface, for better response and modulation.
products.caveats: Vivid's year list jumps from 2017 to 2020 and stops at 2020, which looks like a catalogue artefact; 2021+ not stated. Price did not load. Page is on a staging subdomain (stg.vividracing.com). braking.com not checked.

products.product: Brake Master Cylinder Rebuild Kit, KTM 450 SX-F 2014-2026

fits.notes: SportbikeTrackGear: KTM 450 SX-F 2014-2026 (each year listed); mounting 'Rear / Front'

products.what_it_changes: Service kit: cup seals, O-rings, copper washers and screws (EPDM rubber) to rebuild the master cylinder.
products.caveats: 18-1035 is read from the STG number 'A|1044-18-1035|129' (manufacturer field shows '2'). Page lists mounting as both rear and front, which is unusual for one kit; confirm on allballsracing.com.

products.product: Flame Floating Front Rotor Kit 270mm, Husqvarna 125-501cc
products.what_it_changes: Kit: Flame MX 270mm front rotor, billet caliper relocation bracket and Nitro Sport pads.
products.caveats: Husqvarna-labelled sibling of the KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas kit 310045-PU (bc-006). The page also prints GasGas and other lines identical to those on the Honda and Kawasaki kit pages, so they were treated as cross-listing and not recorded. Husqvarna 2024+ models: caliper brand not addressed by the listing. Out of stock when checked.

products.product: Flame 260mm Floating Front Rotor, Kawasaki 250-450cc
products.what_it_changes: Retailer copy: up to 25% performance gain and up to 20% weight saving claimed; billet aluminium carrier, stainless floaters.
products.supporting_parts: Needs an adapter bracket (sold separately) because the 260mm disc is oversize on these bikes.
products.caveats: No Moto-Master part number on the page. 2024+ KX450 and 2025+ KX250 not listed.

products.product: Front Brake Caliper Relocation Bracket SP027 (GasGas EC)
products.what_it_changes: Relocation bracket for running an oversize front rotor.
products.caveats: Ghostbikes lists only GasGas EC 250 / EC 300 2018-2020 (pre-KTM-era GasGas enduro, out of scope); kept as a lead with no in-scope fits because Ghostbikes' GasGas Galfer collection has no 2021+ MC/EX bracket.

products.product: GBrakes Caliper Relocation Bracket 280mm
variants: J&P item P1175711 (retailer item; 'price depends on fitment', vehicle-specific)
products.what_it_changes: Relocates the stock caliper so a 280mm front rotor can be run; retailer says it improves braking strength and responsiveness; made in USA.
products.supporting_parts: Needs a 280mm rotor (e.g. GBrakes GBDOS224 kit for KTM group). Required for running a 280mm rotor.
products.caveats: Braktec split: J&P stops every GasGas MC line at 2023 while KTM and Husqvarna run to 2027, which matches the 2024+ GasGas Braktec caliper change. No Galfer part numbers per bike. KTM 250 SX, 250 SX-F and Husqvarna FC 450 are missing from the list (not explained). Yamaha list truncated after YZ450FX.

products.product: Flame 260mm Floating Front Rotor, KTM / Husqvarna / GasGas / Husaberg 125-530cc
products.what_it_changes: Retailer copy: up to 25% performance gain and up to 20% weight saving claimed; billet aluminium hub, stainless floaters.
products.supporting_parts: Needs an adapter bracket to reposition the stock caliper, sold separately.
products.caveats: No Moto-Master part number. List cut off at KTM 400 SX, so 450 SX-F/XC-F and others are missing. GasGas lines are inconsistent (MC 250F stops 2023 but MC 450F runs to 2027) and do not reflect the 2024+ Braktec caliper; check caliper before buying.

products.product: 280 Tsunami Kit, Honda CRF250R/RX and CRF450R/RX
products.what_it_changes: 280mm solid-mount Tsunami Wave rotor with 6061-T6 aluminium relocation bracket (dealer copy; Galfer-patented rotor, made in the Galfer factory).
products.supporting_parts: Kit includes rotor and bracket; pads not listed.
products.caveats: No Galfer part number on the page. Fitment stops at 2022; 2023+ Honda not listed. Galfer maker tables unreachable (galfer.com redirect).

products.product: G1396R Racing Off-Road Front Brake Pads, KTM SX 85 / Husqvarna TC 85 / GasGas MC 85
products.what_it_changes: Racing compound with a ceramic heat-shield coating and slotted friction material to cut heat transfer; developed with MXGP, AMA Supercross and EnduroGP riders (dealer copy).
products.caveats: '12-..' read as open-ended; the 2025+ 85 SX is a new platform and the dealer does not address it. HH sintered version FD458G1396 seen at JJ Motorsports (17220858, $32.31) without fitment. Price not shown.
